# Section 1 loaded tail, OM-5 1.2

0x138 bytes of 0xFF before section 1's loaded end; the larger free run past that end is not copied to RAM.

**Category:** free space · **Address:** `0x605a76c8` to `0x605a7800` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [om5 firmware 1.2, build 1200](../firmware/om5-1200.md) · **Cameras:** [OM SYSTEM OM-5](../cameras/om5.md)

The boot copy stops at a per-section loaded end below the next section's start. Only the part up to the end is usable; the port's toolchain refuses claims beyond it.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([Caduceus port for the original OM-5 (tadejs)](../projects/caduceus-om5-tadejs.md)): Loaded ends read from the section-copy code and its jump table. Source: [Original OM-5 port notes (tadejs)](../sources/tom5.port.md).
- **Physical camera** ([Caduceus port for the original OM-5 (tadejs)](../projects/caduceus-om5-tadejs.md)): Ladder C4 and C5 trampoline at 0x605a7700 runs on the owner's camera. Source: [Original OM-5 port notes (tadejs)](../sources/tom5.port.md).
